notes.title: Psycho-Sleuth Demo NOW AVAILABLE - Play for FREE!
notes.content:
After months of development, we're thrilled to finally share our demo with you! 

【What's in the Demo】4-5 hours of content including: ✦ Interconnected stories of 13 unique "Afflicted" characters ✦ Investigation, exploration, and debate-driven deduction mechanics ✦ Unravel truth from distorted perceptions and twisted realities 

Play the demo and let us know what you think! If you enjoy it, please wishlist to support the full release!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753800/_PsychoSleuth_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: “Psycho-Sleuth” Wins 3 Awards at Bahamut ACG Creative Contest!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share that Psycho-Sleuth has received three awards at the 2024 Bahamut ACG Creative Contest:

🏆 Silver Award
📈 Market Potential Award 🎖️ SGArts Special Award

This recognition is a huge encouragement for our small team. We've been dedicated to crafting a story that blends unique characters, psychological disorders, and classic detective elements—and it's incredibly rewarding to be acknowledged by industry veterans and expert judges.Thank you to all the players and supporters who’ve been with us on this journey.
We’ll keep polishing the game to deliver the best experience we can.
Free Demo Coming: September 25, 2025
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432860/PsychoSleuth/?l=tchinese"][/dynamiclink]💡 Add to your wishlist!
You'll be notified the moment our free demo and future updates go live.

Don't miss the beginning of this psychological mystery journey!

notes.title: Psycho-Sleuth is coming to BitSummit 2025!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Psycho-Sleuth will be exhibited at BitSummit 2025 in Kyoto, Japan on July 19–20. This will be our first showcase in Japan, and we can't wait to meet you there!

📍 Booth: 3F EP-06
🌟 Demo available to play
🎁 Get a free gift by adding the game to your Steam wishlist!

We’ll also be showing behind-the-scenes content including hand-drawn animation sketches, and inviting players to experience the twisted mysteries and cognitive distortions of Psycho-Sleuth in person.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621464/d58ef0dccded832a8ebadbe47a073821e257df2b.png"]If you're attending BitSummit, come say hi—and don’t forget to wishlist us!


🔗 Steam Page: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432860/PsychoSleuth"][/dynamiclink]
